professionalSummary: Staff Software Engineer at a cloud software company since 2022, leading technical direction across ingestion, storage, and query teams.
Authored the 2023 and 2025 technical strategies and fourteen architecture decision records for the platform.
Chair of the platform design review and active participant in the company’s technical steering group.
Coached five senior engineers under a documented engineering coaching practice.
Documented open questions and boundaries for all decision records and design reviews.
experienceHighlights: Staff Software Engineer, observability platform (2022–present) – set technical direction across three teams.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Design review outcome with boundary note

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to confirm independent verification of evidence and assess depth of technical direction across teams.

evidence.text: Staff Software Engineer for the observability platform of a cloud software company since 2022, setting the platform's technical direction across its ingestion, storage and query teams; senior software engineer on the storage team from 2018 to 2022.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of staff-level direction across three teams.

evidence.text: Wrote the platform's technical strategy for 2023 and 2025 and the fourteen architecture decision records the three teams built against, all under my name in the platform's architecture repository.
evidence.notes: Explicit authorship of strategy and ADRs.

evidence.text: Chaired the platform design review from 2022, with the review calendar and the review outcomes in the repository, and represented the platform in the company's technical steering group, where the steering group minutes record the platform items under my name.
evidence.notes: Chairing design review and representation in steering group.

evidence.text: Coached the five senior engineers across the three teams under the engineering coaching practice, with the coaching agreements filed with the engineering managers.
Wrote the open questions section of each decision record and the boundary note of each design review, stating what was left undecided.
evidence.notes: Documentation of open questions and boundaries.
